## Overview

<<prodname>> sandbox mode offers support for WhatsApp via messaging API v1. For more information, please refer to our [WhatsApp API Reference](https://developers.webexconnect.io/reference/whatsapp-api-docs) documentation.

> 📘 Note
> 
> For more information on the types of WhatsApp message supported, refer to the [WhatsApp API](https://developers.webexconnect.io/reference/whatsapp-api-docs) documentation.

## Authentication

<<prodname>> sandbox mode currently supports key based authentication using Service Key. JWT Authentication that's supported as part of the production accounts isn't available in sandbox mode at the moment.
